head: 5754d2aa
headSubject: chore(ledger): note RUN-31 recurrence under full kernel-gate parallel load
summary: Closed out Session 1's live-browser verification loose ends. Ran the targeted AggregateRuntime/BalanceEvaluator/WorkbenchRuntime unit tests (green), then used ScrapForAI to resolve the one open question (maxQuantity readOnly after Save+reselect): confirmed a real bug, not a test-methodology flaw. Root cause: workbench-page.html.mustache's view() function projects descriptor.sections[]/bands[] into the shape render() actually reads, but never copied the readOnlyColumns field through, so isReadOnlyColumn() always returned false regardless of correct server metadata. Fixed and verified live (readonly="" now present in the DOM). Ran full quality gates repeatedly to get a clean baseline: found and fixed a real coverage-ratchet regression (AggregateApiController's new errorBody() method had zero test coverage -- added AggregateApiControllerTest, previously nonexistent), and a real surface-classification gate failure (BalanceEvaluator, added by Session 1's already-committed commit, was never registered in runtime-supported-controllers.json -- registered it). Diagnosed two other gate failures as pre-existing/environmental, not caused by this session's files: NPDevCli's test_bench_cli.py/test_npdev_test_verb.py failures were port-8099 contention from my own dsl-conformance-max verification instance (stopped it, reran clean); NPDevKernel's DefaultConceptGatewayDegradedConcurrencyTest is RUN-31 recurring -- already root-caused and partially fixed (5s->30s) in the immediately prior session, but that margin is still insufficient specifically under run-kernel-quality-gate.ps1's own 37-module parallel Gradle invocation (passes standalone every time, including the full unfiltered :kernel:test task alone, and with the machine otherwise idle) -- documented with full isolation evidence in ledger/items/RUN-31.yml rather than re-chased (wrong subsystem for this session). Committed as two commits: 081de056 (the four bug fixes + new test + classification registration + coverage baseline) and 5754d2aa (the RUN-31 ledger note).
nextStep: Start Session 2 of NPDEV_MEGA_ROADMAP.md (closing the AI authoring loop), per the roadmap's dependency graph -- Session 1 (including its live-browser verification follow-up) is now fully done and committed. Before starting, run /prep as usual; NPDevKernel's own gate will likely still show RUN-31's DefaultConceptGatewayDegradedConcurrencyTest as flaky under run-kernel-quality-gate.ps1's full parallel run specifically (not under run-all-gates.ps1's other three gates, and not standalone) -- this is pre-existing and documented, not a new regression to chase; see ledger/items/RUN-31.yml's 2026-09-14 (later same day) update for the exact isolation evidence and three suggested fix directions (further widening, reducing Gradle's parallel-fork count for that invocation, or restructuring the test off wall-clock joins) if someone wants to actually close it.
verified: Targeted unit tests (AggregateRuntime/BalanceEvaluator/WorkbenchRuntime, gradlew -p NPDevRuntimeHost/runtimehost-core test) green. run-runtimehost-gate.ps1 green (twice, after each fix). run-generator-gate.ps1 and the AI-knowledge gate green as part of two full run-all-gates.ps1 attempts. run-kernel-quality-gate.ps1 and its underlying :kernel:test task both verified green in isolation (no other modules in the invocation); fails only when run alongside all 36 adapter test tasks in one Gradle invocation -- see RUN-31 note. Live ScrapForAI browser re-verification confirms the readOnlyColumns fix: maxQuantity now serializes readonly="" in the DOM after Save+reselect, matching the server's already-correct descriptor.
